Name: Lnh's Sunshine Shed CP and PIF
Author: liunianhui

[center][size=4][color=#ffff00]接受地图绘制委托，如果你正在制作mod，需要找人绘制地图，那么请联系我。
Accept the commission of map drawing. If you are making mod and need to find someone to draw a map, please contact me.[/color]

[color=#00ff00]这是一个PIF小屋，有一小块种植区，温室效果，地板和壁纸都可以更换，同时也可以替换原版小屋，在配置中修改。
This is a PIF shed with a small planting area, like greenhouse, and the floors and walls can be replaced. The valley shed can also be replaced and modified in the config file.

[/color][color=#ff0000]尽量避免在游戏中取消替换小屋，会出现图块显示错误，如果不小心取消了，重新进入游戏即可回复。
Do not cancel the replacement shed in the game, as there may be tile display errors. If you accidentally cancel the replacement, you can restore it by re entering the game.[/color]
